baseline_PASS_rule: Every baseline PASS must remain PASS, including all reftests and policy observations.
retained_FAIL_rule: Every retained FAIL must preserve its complete normalized diagnostic and expectation/intermittent fields exactly.
additional_improvement_rule: Enumerate every additional FAIL-to-PASS identity and its baseline diagnostic for independent review; no blanket approval or executable waiver.
restored_rule: All 1540 normalized outcomes must match the authenticated baseline union exactly, including metadata and failure diagnostics.
calibration_rule: Font, geometry, literal, DOM-order and fixture lifecycle failures are not repair witnesses. Exact target declaration-admission, setter-retention, or target semantic assertions may establish a NameRepeat baseline witness only after preceding calibrations passed.
